All About New Jersey

New Jersey is a state in the United States, located in the Northeast. It’s a small state but has a lot of people living there. It’s surrounded by New York, the Atlantic Ocean, Pennsylvania, and Delaware. Even though it’s not big, it has almost 9.3 million people living there. The capital is Trenton, and the biggest city is Newark.

Hawthorne is a small town in Passaic County, which is in the state of New Jersey in the United States. In the year 2020, about 19,637 people lived in Hawthorne. This was more than before, with around 846 extra people compared to 2010. Back then, there were 18,791 people. And even before that, in the year 2000, there were 18,218 people.

Hawthorne used to be part of a bigger place called Manchester Township. Later, it was split into different towns, including Hawthorne. This happened along with towns like Haledon, North Haledon, and others. Hawthorne officially became its own town on March 24, 1898, after a decision by the government.
